fields.title: UNITED PARCEL SERVICE INC General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: On May 15, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement (the “Underwriting Agreement”) with the underwriters listed on Schedule I thereto (the “Underwriters”), whereby the Company agreed to sell and the Underwriters agreed to purchase from the Company, subject to and upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Underwriting Agreement, $170,673,000 principal amount of Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2075 (the “Transaction”).

1.1+ Underwriting Agreement 4.1 Form of Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2075 5.1 Opinion of King & Spalding LLP 23.1 Consent of King & Spalding LLP (included in Exhibit 5.1) 104 Cover Page Interactive Data File + Portions of this exhibit have been redacted in accordance with Item 601(a)(5) of Regulation S-K.
capital_allocation_activity: In January 2023, the Board approved a share repurchase authorization for up to $5.0 billion of class A and class B common stock.
As of December 31, 2025, we had $1.3 billion available under our share repurchase authorization.
liquidity_notes: The amount of commercial paper outstanding fluctuates based on daily liquidity needs.
governance_notes: (“UPS”), upon recommendation of the Board’s Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, increased the size of the Board to thirteen members and appointed John Morikis, age 61, to the Board, effective immediately.
controls_and_risk_notes: Controls and Procedures Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures As of the end of the period covered by this report, management, including our Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial and Accounting Officer, evaluated the effectiveness of the design and operation of our disclosure controls and procedures.
